server_name.title: Server Name
server_name.description: Display name shown to players when they browse or join this Core Keeper world.

game_id.title: Steam Game ID
game_id.description: Optional stable join code for SDR mode. Leave blank to let LanGame derive a consistent alphanumeric ID from this instance.

max_players.title: Max Players
max_players.description: Maximum simultaneous connections; additional players are rejected when the server is full. LanGame supports values from 1 to 100. Higher limits need more server resources.

world_index.title: World Slot
world_index.description: Which world slot inside this instance's managed data path should be loaded.

world_seed.title: World Seed
world_seed.description: Seed text for newly created worlds. Leave blank to let the server generate one.

hashed_world_seed.title: Hashed World Seed
hashed_world_seed.description: Unsigned 32-bit seed hash for restoring a world when the original seed text is unavailable. Core Keeper ignores it whenever World Seed is not empty.

world_mode.title: World Mode
world_mode.description: Core Keeper world difficulty and pacing mode.

season_override.title: Season Override
season_override.description: Force one seasonal event, or keep automatic date-based behavior.

max_packets_per_frame.title: Snapshot Packet Budget
max_packets_per_frame.description: Snapshot size budget per remote client, in 1,200-byte units, capped at 9,440 bytes. 1 keeps the default snapshot target; larger values allow more state data in each snapshot. This is not a server-wide packet limit.

network_send_rate.title: Network Snapshot Rate (Hz)
network_send_rate.description: Target number of state snapshots sent to each client per second. The server caps this at its simulation tick rate; increasing it raises network and serialization work.

direct_connection_enabled.title: Use Direct Connection Mode
direct_connection_enabled.description: Use direct IP:port joins instead of Steam relay mode. LanGame enables this by default because anonymous dedicated-server startup can fail during Steam relay login without an interactive Steam account. Hosting over the internet still requires opening the UDP port on Windows Firewall and your router.

join_password.title: Join Password
join_password.description: Used for direct IP joins. New instances receive a unique password that can be shared with invited players.

allowed_platform_code.title: Allowed Platform
allowed_platform_code.description: Optional direct-connect restriction for one PC storefront. Only applies when direct mode is enabled.

admin_list.title: Admin Steam64 IDs
admin_list.description: One Steam64 ID per line. LanGame materializes Admins.json for this instance's data path.

ban_list.title: Banned Steam64 IDs
ban_list.description: One Steam64 ID per line. LanGame materializes PlayerBans.json for this instance.
